ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BOAR uses your location, read on this device, to answer questions about places near you, such as restaurants in the city you are in. It is never sent anywhere.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BOAR uses the microphone only while voice input is on, to turn your question into text on this device.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: BOAR transcribes your voice question on this device. Audio is never sent to a server.
